verdict.rationale: Granola has a dedicated model-training help page stating that users can opt out of model training in Settings, at any time. That is a first-party, user-controlled way to keep their data out of AI training. Training appears to be on by default, and the docs shown are brief. Missing for 10: detail on what the opt-out covers (e.g., third-party LLM providers or subprocessors, transcripts versus notes), workspace or admin-level enforcement, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the setting works.
